coasters.simpleMeaning: Big fun train rides with fast drops and loops
coasters.contextMeaning: Large amusement park trains with tracks that go up and down fast
coasters.sentence: This episode is inspired by a recent news-style question many people ask after seeing huge roller coasters online: why do they feel so scary, but still count as safe?

restraints.simpleMeaning: Things that hold you safe in your seat
restraints.contextMeaning: Safety bars that keep people from moving during the ride
restraints.sentence: They use restraints, brakes, and strong rules.

tightens.simpleMeaning: Your chest feels very small and hard inside
tightens.contextMeaning: Your chest muscles squeeze close together when you feel scared
tightens.sentence: That is why your chest tightens and your breathing changes.

climbs.simpleMeaning: The train goes up the hill very slowly
climbs.contextMeaning: The ride vehicle moves upward along the track step by step

reacts.simpleMeaning: Your brain answers quickly to new things
reacts.contextMeaning: Your mind quickly notices and responds to fast movements and heights
reacts.sentence: Your brain reacts very fast to height, speed, and sudden turns.

inspect.simpleMeaning: Workers look at everything to make sure it is safe
inspect.contextMeaning: Staff check the safety bars carefully before the ride starts
inspect.sentence: Operators inspect the bars before the train leaves.

thrilling.simpleMeaning: Very exciting and fun in a scary way
thrilling.contextMeaning: The upcoming ride part feels super exciting and full of joy
thrilling.sentence: The next moment can feel thrilling.

shaken.simpleMeaning: Your whole body moves around a lot
shaken.contextMeaning: Your body jiggles and moves because of the fast ride
shaken.sentence: The body may feel shaken, but it is still controlled.

coaster.simpleMeaning: A big train ride with fast drops and loops
coaster.contextMeaning: The amusement park vehicle that goes up and down quickly
coaster.sentence: A roller coaster can create a strong feeling of danger, even when it is built with safety in mind.

sweaty.simpleMeaning: Your palms feel wet and sticky from nerves
sweaty.contextMeaning: Your hands become damp and wet because you are nervous
sweaty.sentence: Your hands feel sweaty before the ride even begins.

roller.simpleMeaning: Part of the ride name meaning going over bumps
roller.contextMeaning: The first word in the ride name that describes the track
roller.sentence: This episode is inspired by a recent news-style question many people ask after seeing huge roller coasters online: why do they feel so scary, but still count as safe?

brakes.simpleMeaning: Parts that stop the train from going too fast
brakes.contextMeaning: Machine parts on the track that slow down the moving train
brakes.sentence: Then the track uses curves and brakes to manage that speed.

restraint.simpleMeaning: A safety bar that holds you in your seat
restraint.contextMeaning: The metal bar across your lap that keeps you seated
restraint.sentence: Riders also have restraint bars or lap bars.

frightening.simpleMeaning: Something that makes you feel very scared
frightening.contextMeaning: The storm seems very scary, even though you are safe inside
frightening.sentence: You can say, “It feels scary, but it is safe.” You can also say, “The storm feels frightening, but the house is secure.” Or, “The exam feels hard, but it is possible.” This pattern helps you show contrast.

riders.simpleMeaning: People who sit on the fun train ride
riders.contextMeaning: The guests sitting in the train cars during the drop
riders.sentence: On a steep drop, many riders feel their stomach rise.

thrill.simpleMeaning: A happy feeling when something exciting happens
thrill.contextMeaning: The happy excitement your brain feels from the ride

safe.simpleMeaning: Not hurting you or keeping you from danger
safe.contextMeaning: The rides protect people even when they look scary
safe.sentence: This episode is inspired by a recent news-style question many people ask after seeing huge roller coasters online: why do they feel so scary, but still count as safe?

uncertainty.simpleMeaning: When you do not know what comes next
uncertainty.contextMeaning: The worry of not knowing how the ride will move
uncertainty.sentence: Some fear comes from uncertainty, which means not knowing what will happen.
